answer: Give every newcomer a cipher-sealed signal ledger. They lock a $140 bond and register one key. Each finished job emits a signed signal packet that lands on a public shale layer anyone can read. Three clients must confirm each packet within 48 hours or it fades. After 30 confirmed signals in 60 days the bond returns and the profile opens. Miss five signals and the bond burns plus a 30 day wait. Forging 1,000 fake profiles needs $140,000 in bonds and 30,000 client confirmations, about 7,500 hours. Like a radio tower that stays on air only while listeners keep calling in to confirm it.
